parts.rubric: For each question, choose the correct answer (A, B or C). In the exam the options are pictures; here they are written.

segments.speaker: girl
segments.text: I'm going to Emma's party on Saturday. Shall I make a cake?

segments.speaker: boy
segments.text: I think her mum's already made one. She asked me to bring some drinks.

segments.speaker: girl
segments.text: Oh, OK. Then I'll bring my speaker and put together a playlist. Nobody else will think of the music.

questions.prompt: What will the girl take to the party?
questions.explanation_es: La tarta ya la ha hecho la madre de Emma y las bebidas las lleva él; ella llevará el altavoz y una lista de canciones.

segments.speaker: mark
segments.text: Hi, it's Mark. I've got the tickets for tonight.

segments.speaker: mark
segments.text: I thought the film was at quarter to seven, but that's when the doors open. It actually begins at quarter past.

segments.speaker: mark
segments.text: Let's meet outside at seven, so we're not in a hurry. See you later.

questions.prompt: What time does the film start?
questions.explanation_es: A las siete menos cuarto abren las puertas y a las siete quedan fuera; la película empieza «at quarter past» (7.15).

segments.speaker: woman
segments.text: You're soaking wet! Where's your umbrella?

segments.speaker: man
segments.text: I wish I knew. I had it when I got off the bus, I'm sure of that.

segments.speaker: woman
segments.text: Maybe it's at the office.

segments.speaker: man
segments.text: No, I didn't go in today. Oh! I stopped for a coffee on the way here. I put it under the table. It must still be there.

questions.prompt: Where did the man leave his umbrella?
questions.explanation_es: Lo tenía al bajar del autobús y hoy no ha ido a la oficina; lo dejó debajo de la mesa cuando paró a tomar un café.

segments.speaker: mum
segments.text: The holiday centre has lots of activities. You liked horse riding last year, didn't you?

segments.speaker: boy
segments.text: It was OK, but I've done it now. What else is there?

segments.speaker: mum
segments.text: Sailing, and there's a climbing wall.

segments.speaker: boy
segments.text: I'd love to go sailing, but it says you have to be sixteen. So I'll put my name down for climbing.

questions.prompt: Which activity is the boy going to do?
questions.explanation_es: Montar a caballo ya lo hizo, y para la vela hay que tener dieciséis años, así que se apunta a escalada.

segments.speaker: presenter
segments.text: And now, the weather for tomorrow. It'll be a wet start to the day, with heavy rain across the whole area until about eleven.

segments.speaker: presenter
segments.text: After lunch, the clouds will move away, and we can expect several hours of sunshine. Enjoy it while you can, because strong winds are on the way for the evening.

questions.prompt: What will the weather be like tomorrow afternoon?
questions.explanation_es: Lluvia por la mañana, sol «after lunch» y viento por la tarde-noche. La pregunta es por la tarde.

segments.speaker: man
segments.text: I'm going to the shop. Do we need anything?

segments.speaker: woman
segments.text: Let me look. There's plenty of milk, and I bought bread yesterday. Oh, I used the last eggs for the cake this morning. Could you get half a dozen?

segments.speaker: man
segments.text: Sure.

questions.prompt: What does the woman ask the man to buy?
questions.explanation_es: Leche hay de sobra y el pan lo compró ayer; gastó los últimos huevos en la tarta y le pide media docena.

segments.speaker: girl
segments.text: Dad, are we driving to the airport on Friday?

segments.speaker: dad
segments.text: No, parking there costs a fortune for two weeks. I was going to book a taxi, but with five of us and all the bags, we'd need two.

segments.speaker: dad
segments.text: So we'll take the train. There's one that leaves at six.

segments.speaker: girl
segments.text: Six in the morning?

segments.speaker: dad
segments.text: I'm afraid so.

questions.prompt: How will the family travel to the airport?
questions.explanation_es: El aparcamiento es carísimo y harían falta dos taxis, así que irán en tren.

parts.rubric: For each question, choose the correct answer (A, B or C).

segments.speaker: woman
segments.text: Have you been to that new café by the station?

segments.speaker: man
segments.text: Yes, twice. The sandwiches are great, aren't they? And so cheap for what you get.

segments.speaker: woman
segments.text: I thought they were quite expensive, actually. But the people who work there are lovely. They remembered my name the second time.

segments.speaker: man
segments.text: Yes, they're really nice. It's a shame about the music, though. I could hardly hear my friend speak.

segments.speaker: woman
segments.text: Really? It was quiet when I went.

questions.prompt: You will hear two friends talking about a new café. What do they agree about?
questions.explanation_es: Los dos dicen que el personal es encantador. A ella la comida le pareció cara, y el ruido solo lo notó él.

segments.speaker: girl
segments.text: How was the trip to the science museum?

segments.speaker: boy
segments.text: Well, you know I'm not really into science, so I wasn't looking forward to it. And the coach took three hours, which wasn't great, but we played cards.

segments.speaker: boy
segments.text: Then we got there and... it was brilliant! You could do all these experiments yourself. I didn't expect to like it at all.

questions.prompt: You will hear a boy telling a friend about a school trip. How did he feel about it?
questions.explanation_es: No le apetecía nada y resultó «brilliant»: no esperaba que le gustara. El viaje fue largo, pero jugaron a las cartas.

segments.speaker: man
segments.text: So, are you happy in the new place?

segments.speaker: woman
segments.text: Very. It's smaller than my old flat, to be honest, and I only look out onto a car park.

segments.speaker: woman
segments.text: But I can walk to work in ten minutes, and there's a market on the corner. After two years of sitting on a bus every morning, that's what matters to me.

questions.prompt: You will hear a woman talking to a friend about her new flat. What does she like most about it?
questions.explanation_es: Es más pequeño y da a un aparcamiento, pero va andando al trabajo en diez minutos: lo que le importa es dónde está.

segments.speaker: boy
segments.text: Bad luck on Saturday. Three–nil!

segments.speaker: girl
segments.text: It wasn't bad luck. Everyone keeps saying that, but we just stood there and watched. Nobody ran, nobody wanted the ball.

segments.speaker: boy
segments.text: They're a strong team, though.

segments.speaker: girl
segments.text: Not really. We beat them easily last year. No, we were lazy, and we got what we deserved.

questions.prompt: You will hear two friends talking about a football match. What does the girl think about her team?
options: They did not try hard enough.
The other team was much better.
questions.explanation_es: Niega que fuera mala suerte y que el rival sea fuerte: «we were lazy», nadie corrió ni quiso el balón.

segments.speaker: woman
segments.text: I didn't know you cycled to work.

segments.speaker: man
segments.text: I started last month. Everyone thinks it's for the exercise, and yes, I do feel healthier.

segments.speaker: man
segments.text: But really, I was just tired of sitting in my car for forty minutes every morning, not moving. On the bike it takes fifteen. It's cheaper too, of course, but that wasn't the reason.

questions.prompt: You will hear a man talking to a colleague about cycling to work. Why did he start?
questions.explanation_es: Estaba harto de pasar cuarenta minutos parado en el coche. Se encuentra mejor y es más barato, pero dice que esa no fue la razón.

segments.speaker: girl
segments.text: Have you finished that book I lent you?

segments.speaker: boy
segments.text: Nearly. I almost gave up after the first fifty pages, because nothing happens. But then it gets really exciting.

segments.speaker: girl
segments.text: I know! And the people in it feel so real, don't they?

segments.speaker: boy
segments.text: Yes, especially the grandmother. Don't tell me how it ends. I've got twenty pages left.

questions.prompt: You will hear two friends talking about a book. What does the boy say about it?
questions.explanation_es: Casi lo deja en las primeras cincuenta páginas «because nothing happens». Los personajes le parecen reales y el final aún no lo ha leído.

parts.rubric: For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one or two words or a number or a date or a time. You will hear a woman called Helen giving information about a summer drama course.
parts.title: Summer drama course

gaps.explanation_es: Empiezan a las nueve y media y «we finish at four in the afternoon».
«This year we'll be working on a comedy», titulada «The Wrong Suitcase».
Hay que llevar «a packed lunch» porque la cafetería estará cerrada. Las bebidas son gratis.
«Each student can invite three guests». El siete es la hora de la función.
El formulario se recoge «from the library or from our website».

segments.speaker: helen
segments.text: Hello, everyone. I'm Helen, and I'm here to tell you about this year's summer drama course at the Riverside Theatre.

segments.speaker: helen
segments.text: The course is for young people aged thirteen to seventeen, and it runs for two weeks, starting on the fifteenth of July. We meet every day from Monday to Friday. Classes start at half past nine, and we finish at four in the afternoon.

segments.speaker: helen
segments.text: This year we'll be working on a comedy. It's called The Wrong Suitcase, and it was written specially for us by a local writer. Everyone will have a part, so don't worry if you've never acted before.

segments.speaker: helen
segments.text: You don't need to bring much. We'll give you a copy of the play on the first day. Please wear comfortable clothes, and bring a packed lunch, because the theatre café will be closed. Drinks are free.

segments.speaker: helen
segments.text: On the last Friday, we'll perform the play for your families and friends. The show starts at seven o'clock in the evening, and each student can invite three guests.

segments.speaker: helen
segments.text: The course costs eighty-five pounds. If you'd like to come, you need to fill in a form, which you can get from the library or from our website. Please return it by the end of May, as there are only thirty places.

segments.speaker: helen
segments.text: If you have any questions, you can call me on oh one nine six, five five five, oh one four two. Thank you.

parts.rubric: For each question, choose the correct answer (A, B or C). You will hear an interview with a young woman called Maya Torres, who works as a tour guide.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Today I'm talking to Maya Torres, who works as a tour guide. Maya, how did you get the job?

segments.speaker: maya
segments.text: By accident, really. I was studying history at university, and I needed to earn some money in the summer.

segments.speaker: maya
segments.text: A friend of mine was working for a tour company, and she told me they were looking for people who spoke English and Spanish. I'd never thought of being a guide before.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: What was your first tour like?

segments.speaker: maya
segments.text: Terrible! I'd learned all the dates and names, so I wasn't worried about forgetting things. But I talked much too fast, because I was nervous, and I finished the whole tour in forty minutes instead of ninety.

segments.speaker: maya
segments.text: The tourists were very kind about it, but I was so embarrassed.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: What do visitors enjoy most?

segments.speaker: maya
segments.text: You might think it's the cathedral or the castle, and of course they take a lot of photos there. But what people really remember are the stories about ordinary people who lived here. The baker who hid money in his bread, that kind of thing. Nobody remembers the dates.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Is there anything you don't like about the job?

segments.speaker: maya
segments.text: I don't mind the walking, and I've got used to working at weekends. The hard thing is the weather.

segments.speaker: maya
segments.text: When it's pouring with rain, and you've got twenty people who've paid for a tour, you can't cancel. You just have to smile and carry on, with water running down your neck.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Have you ever had a strange question?

segments.speaker: maya
segments.text: All the time! Last week a man asked me what time the castle was built. Not what year. What time!

segments.speaker: maya
segments.text: But my favourite was a little girl who asked if the statue in the square came alive at night. I told her I wasn't sure, and that she should come back and check.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: And what are your plans for the future?

segments.speaker: maya
segments.text: Well, I finish university next year. My parents would like me to become a teacher, and I did think about it.

segments.speaker: maya
segments.text: But I've decided I'd like to start my own company, doing tours for small groups. Maybe by bike. I'll need to save some money first, so I'll carry on with this job for a while.

questions.prompt: Why did Maya become a tour guide?
options: She had always wanted to be one.
One of her teachers suggested it.
questions.explanation_es: Necesitaba ganar dinero en verano y una amiga le habló de la empresa. Nunca había pensado en ser guía.

questions.prompt: What went wrong on Maya's first tour?
options: She forgot some of the information.
questions.explanation_es: Habló tan deprisa por los nervios que acabó en cuarenta minutos en vez de noventa. No olvidó nada y los turistas fueron amables.

questions.prompt: According to Maya, what do visitors like best?
questions.explanation_es: Lo que recuerdan son las historias de la gente corriente, como el panadero que escondía dinero en el pan.

questions.prompt: What does Maya find difficult about her job?
questions.explanation_es: «The hard thing is the weather»: con lluvia no se puede cancelar. Andar no le importa y a los fines de semana se ha acostumbrado.

questions.prompt: What did a little girl want to know?
options: whether a statue moved at night
questions.explanation_es: La niña preguntó si la estatua de la plaza cobraba vida por la noche. Lo del castillo lo preguntó un señor.

questions.prompt: What does Maya want to do in the future?
questions.explanation_es: Sus padres querrían que fuera profesora, pero ha decidido montar su propia empresa de visitas para grupos pequeños.
